messages:
liam_prod: Hey team — CopperLane kickoff. They're aiming for Redwood Private with EU data residency + SSO (Okta). Target go‑live ~6 weeks. Main risks: SSO cert exchange, data residency approvals, and enablement timeline. Can we align owners + success criteria?

maria_csm: I'll own the CSM lane. +1 on Okta workstream. Suggest a 30‑minute kickoff with customer next Tue 10am CET. I'll send calendar invite. :calendar:

ajay_eng: Quick Qs — expected steady qps and peak tokens/day? Which model family are they planning to serve (LlamaX/CodeX-style)? SP metadata for SAML will be needed. Estimate 1–2 weeks for base SSO integration once we have metadata and test tenant.

liam_prod: Peak ~12 QPS, avg 250k tokens/day in pilot, model preference: open LLM, we're flexible. I'll share token profile + example prompts by EOD.

sarah_se: I'll build the enablement playbook and training plan. Proposed schedule: enablement session Wk2, docs & runbook delivered before pilot. Also want to shadow first 3 support incidents.

katie_security: FYI we require KMS integration details and proof of EU data path. If those aren't cleared before pilot, there's a material renewal risk flagged — customer legal needs a data flow diagram and encryption at rest statement.

maria_csm: Agenda for next Tue: intros, timeline, success criteria, integration blockers. Proposed success criteria (high level):
- Latency SLA <200ms p50 on pilot traffic
- End‑to‑end SSO SAML working for 3 user groups
- Data stored exclusively in EU region and KMS keys in customer's tenant
- Two enablement sessions completed and one runbook handed off
- Initial quality/regression eval at 0.7 pass rate on customer prompts

ajay_eng: I'll take SSO + infra validation. Assigning to ajay_eng. Need SP metadata & test account creds from CopperLane.

sarah_se: I'll take enablement and runbook, will prepare a checklist. Also recommend we capture 10 canonical prompts for eval harness.

liam_prod: I'll send SP metadata and sample dataset by tomorrow. Also looping in emma (CopperLane security) who will upload KMS specs.

deploy-bot: Meeting created: "CopperLane — Redwood Private kickoff" Tue 10:00 CET (link: https://calendar.redwood/invite/abc123). Invite sent to liam_prod, maria_csm, ajay_eng, sarah_se, katie_security.

maria_csm: Action items summary ->
``` 
- liam_prod: send SP metadata + sample prompts (by 1708543200)
- ajay_eng: start SSO integration plan (ETA 2w)
- katie_security: confirm KMS path & EU residency docs (review by legal)
- sarah_se: enablement playbook draft (Wk1 deliverable)
- maria_csm: kickoff invite + weekly sync cadence
```

liam_prod: Sounds good. Also request: we'll run a short NPS survey at 30 days and collect qualitative feedback; will Redwood store eval results in shared S3 or do you prefer Redboard?

sarah_se: Prefer shared S3 bucket for customer-owned artifacts. I'll add eval links to the runbook.

maria_csm: Cool — I'll track these in the onboarding ticket and ping if blockers pop up. Next sync after kickoff: Friday check-in. :white_check_mark:
